steps.text: Look over the 24 desert/city tiles, then turn them all desert side up - no peeking after that
Shuffle into a 5 x 5 grid with the middle empty (the Storm); compass symbols in the top-left corners, small gaps
{n} Sand markers, light side up, on the tiles around the Storm; the rest in a pile
Remove the 4 parts from the flying machine; keep everything nearby
Sand Storm meter in its holder; clip on the level above the {n}-pawn symbol for your difficulty
Shuffle the Storm deck facedown just above the desert, compass pointing away (North)
Shuffle the Equipment deck facedown beside the desert
Deal 1 random Adventurer card each and read your powers aloud
Meter clip on the top mark of your canteen
steps.note: Water Carrier starts with 5, most others 4

steps.text: Your pawn on the helicopter crash tile; box unused cards and pawns
Sand on a tile with a part goes under the part
The thirstiest player goes first; play continues to the left
